narr: A complex of storms moved over portions of Madison and Delaware county causing widespread flooding and pockets of flash flooding. The rain fell over the course of several hours with amounts of over 6 inches in spots. Conditions had been fairly dry in the days leading up which limited the extent of flash flooding.
ev: Multiple road closures across much of the county with most severe flooding in Muncie. Several cars stalled in the floodwaters with rescues needed. 24 rainfall amounts were highest in Muncie and Yorktown with reports of 6.00 and 6.26 inches at each location.

Multiple road closures across the county due to high water and water flowing over the roads. Rainfall reports indicated a strong rainfall gradient over Anderson, ranging from 2.63 on the south side to 5.81 on the north side of town; the episode's greatest observation was 8.70 in Elwood.
